title: 第25章 听我的准没错第26章 灵脉终结者
content_zh:
云家村，位于落云山庄脚下，几百户人家，每家每户都是云府的长工，延续了上百年。
耕种农田与照料牧场，是云家村的主要职责。
由于云府是修行世家，给的工钱自然不少，攀附着落云山庄这棵大树，云家村的百姓多年来衣食无忧，生活蒸蒸日上。
然而自从老庄主夫妻过世，云家村原本平和的气氛变得人心惶惶。
村子里聚集了不少村民，纷纷眺望着山庄方向，每个人的脸上都带着不安的神色。
刚刚发生的两次大地震荡，让这些村民心惊肉跳，以为有天灾来临。
一个年轻村民跑进了村子，喘着大气道：
“打听到了！后山矿洞坍塌，听说有矿工被活埋了！”
一群村民听罢纷纷议论起来。
“肯定没救了，不知埋死了几个，这是给老庄主陪葬去了啊。”
“老庄主夫妻那么好的人，怎么说没就没了呢，哎，老天瞎眼啊。”
“天灾人祸，云家的大劫啊，落云山庄怕是没希望了，少庄主如果不知悔改，云家就真的完了呀。”
“少庄主从小就聪明，一定能撑起山庄。”
有的村民对云家怀有希望，也有村民对云家失望至极。
人群里一个五大三粗的中年妇人撇嘴道：
“聪明又能怎么样，赌到最后还不是一无所有，我就没听说哪个赌鬼能翻身的，早晚云家村都得被输出去！咱们还是早点找退路的好，等在这里肯定要倒大霉！”
旁边一个村民听着不乐意了，道：
“柱子嫂你说的什么话！这些年云家从没亏待过我们，主家有变故我们无力相助，但也不能私底下咒人家吧。”
五大三粗的柱子嫂一翻白眼，掐腰开骂：
“我说错了吗！少庄主难道不是赌鬼？山庄是他输出去，老庄主也是被他气死的！这种人什么事都干得出来，早晚会把云家村给卖了！到时候卖给妖族，我们这些人谁也活不成！柱子你说是不是！”

她掐了把身旁憨头憨脑的丈夫，咬牙切齿。
“是！”柱子抄着手吭了一声。
柱子嫂撇着大嘴继续道：
“要我说啊，与其早晚被那个赌鬼卖掉，不如我们云家村再找一个靠山，咱们去投奔黑熊寨！云家完了，黑熊寨就是附近最大的势力，投奔黑熊寨，至少咱们云家村能保存下来！”
有村民听罢惊呼起来：
“你疯了吧！投奔妖族那不是羊入虎口！况且黑熊寨早有规矩，想要攀附，每家每户先要交出一个娃子当做血食！”
想起黑熊寨的规矩，村民们不寒而栗，谁能舍得用自家孩子去喂妖。
“交个娃子怎么了，至少能保个平安！”
柱子嫂信誓旦旦的道：“昨天我亲眼看到黑熊寨的二当家气势汹汹进了山庄，你们不信就等着瞧吧，那个赌鬼用不了几天就得把云家村卖出去，到时候咱们一个也活不成！”
阴郁的气氛，渐渐笼罩了整个村落。
村民们散去之后变得惶恐不安，有些胆小的已经开始在盘算自家有几个娃子了。
“一群傻子，没一个有见识的！”
五大三粗的柱子嫂回到家之后，关上门得意洋洋的道：“我这叫先见之明！舍掉些娃子而已，保住整个村子，这才叫聪明人！”
“嗯！”柱子憨声憨气的认可。
“一天就知道嗯嗯嗯，一脚踹不出个屁的孬货！跟着你倒了八辈子血霉了！连个娃子都生不出来！”
柱子嫂没好气的数落道：“过几天咱俩去一趟黑熊寨，就说云家村想要归附，每家每户都会交出一个娃子给熊老爷尝鲜，到时候熊老爷一高兴，咱们非但不用交娃子，没准还能当个村长。”
柱子犹豫道：“还是买个娃子吧。”
content_en:
Yunjia Village is located at the foot of Luoyun Villa. There are hundreds of families, and each family is a long-term worker of Yun Mansion, which has lasted for hundreds of years.
Cultivating farmland and caring for pastures are the main responsibilities of Yunjia Village.
Since the Yun Mansion is a family of practitioners, they are naturally given a lot of wages. By clinging to the big tree of Luoyun Villa, the people of Yunjia Village have been able to live a prosperous life for many years without worrying about food and clothing.
However, since the death of the old village owner and his wife, the originally peaceful atmosphere in Yunjia Village has become panicky.
Many villagers gathered in the village, looking in the direction of the villa. Everyone had an uneasy look on their face.
The two earthquakes that had just occurred frightened these villagers, thinking that a natural disaster was coming.
A young villager ran into the village and gasped:
"I heard about it! The back mountain mine collapsed, and I heard that some miners were buried alive!"
A group of villagers started talking after hearing this.
"It's definitely hopeless. I don't know how many people were buried dead. They were buried with the old village owner."
"The old farm owner and his wife are such good people, how can they disappear without saying a word? Oh, God is blind."
"Natural disasters and man-made disasters are a catastrophe for the Yun family. There is probably no hope for Luoyun Villa. If the young owner does not repent, the Yun family will really be doomed."
"The young owner of the village has been smart since he was a child, and he will definitely be able to support the Villa."
Some villagers have hopes for the Yun family, while others are extremely disappointed with the Yun family.
A thick-set middle-aged woman in the crowd curled her lips and said:
"So what if you're smart? You won't lose anything in the end after gambling. I've never heard of any gambler who can turn around. Sooner or later, Yunjia Village will have to be exported! We'd better find a way out early. We'll definitely be in bad luck if we wait here!"
A villager next to him sounded unhappy and said:
"Sister-in-law Zhuzi, what are you talking about? The Yun family has never treated us badly these years. If something happens to the master's family, we can't help, but we can't curse others in private."
The thick and tall Zhuzi's sister-in-law rolled her eyes, pinched her waist and cursed:
"Am I wrong! Isn't the young village owner a gambler? He exported the village, and the old village owner was also mad at him! This kind of person can do anything, and sooner or later the Yunjia Village will be sold! When the time comes to sell it to the demon clan, none of us will be able to survive! Don't you think so Zhuzhu!"
She pinched her foolish husband beside her and gritted her teeth.
"Yes!" Zhu Zhu said with his hands behind his hands.
Sister-in-law Zhuzi curled her mouth and continued:
"Let me tell you, instead of being sold out by that gambler sooner or later, it is better for our Yunjia Village to find another backer, and we go to the Black Bear Village! The Yun family is finished, and the Black Bear Village is the largest force in the area. If we go to the Black Bear Village, at least our Yunjia Village can survive!"
After hearing this, some villagers exclaimed:
"Are you crazy! Going to the Monster Clan is not like a sheep falling into a tiger's mouth! Moreover, the Black Bear Village has a rule. If you want to join, every family must first hand over a child as blood food!"
Thinking of the rules of Black Bear Village, the villagers shuddered. Who would be willing to use their own children to feed monsters.
"What's wrong with having a baby? At least you can keep yourself safe!"
Sister-in-law Zhuzi said emphatically: "Yesterday I saw with my own eyes the second head of Black Bear Village entering the villa aggressively. If you don't believe it, just wait and see. That gambler will sell Yunjia Village in a few days, and none of us will be able to survive by then!"
A gloomy atmosphere gradually enveloped the entire village.
After the villagers dispersed, they became panicked, and some of the timid ones were already thinking about how many children they would have.
"A bunch of fools, none of them knowledgeable!"
After the tall and tall Zhu Zhu's sister-in-law returned home, she closed the door and said triumphantly: "This is called foresight! I just gave up some children and saved the whole village. This is called a smart person!"
"Yeah!" Zhu Zhu acknowledged in a naive voice.
"You know it in just one day, eh, eh, you can't beat the bastard! I've been with you for eight lifetimes, and I can't even give birth to a baby!"
Sister-in-law Zhuzi scolded angrily: "In a few daysWe went to Black Bear Village the next day and told Yunjia Village that if they want to join us, every household will hand over a baby to Mr. Xiong for a taste. When Mr. Xiong is happy, not only will we not have to hand over the baby, but we may also be able to become the village chief. "
Zhu Zhu hesitated and said: "Let's buy a baby. "
